verdict.rationale: Opting out of vendor telemetry is a fair question for an error-monitoring SaaS that ships SDKs, a CLI, and an MCP server, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented opt-out of BugSnag's own telemetry or usage tracking. The closest items are adjacent features: retroactive redaction of sensitive data, before-notify callbacks that filter which error events get reported, and self-hosted on-premise deployment. None of these is a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so they earn no credit.
